SELECT a.account_id, a.account, a.nickname, a.status AS account_status, a.created_at, a.last_login_at, CASE WHEN pa.account_id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS has_pet_home, COALESCE(pa.bones, 0) AS bones, COALESCE(pa.food, 0) AS food, COALESCE(pa.makeup_cards, 0) AS makeup_cards, COALESCE(pa.dog_slots, 0) AS dog_slots, COALESCE(pa.energy, 0) AS energy, COALESCE(pa.energy_limit, 0) AS energy_limit, pa.energy_date, pa.companion_dog_id, pa.updated_at AS pet_updated_at, COALESCE(d.dog_count, 0) AS dog_count, COALESCE(d.exploring_dog_count, 0) AS exploring_dog_count, d.dog_summary, COALESCE(i.item_kind_count, 0) AS item_kind_count, COALESCE(i.item_total_count, 0) AS item_total_count, i.item_summary, COALESCE(s.skin_kind_count, 0) AS skin_kind_count, COALESCE(s.skin_total_count, 0) AS skin_total_count, s.skin_summary, COALESCE(c.collection_kind_count, 0) AS collection_kind_count, COALESCE(c.collection_total_count, 0) AS collection_total_count, c.collection_summary FROM accounts a LEFT JOIN pet_assets pa ON pa.account_id = a.account_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT owner_id AS account_id, COUNT(*) AS dog_count, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'exploring' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS exploring_dog_count, GROUP_CONCAT(name || ':' || breed || ':' || stage || ':' || status, '|') AS dog_summary FROM dogs GROUP BY owner_id ) d ON d.account_id = a.account_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS item_kind_count, SUM(count) AS item_total_count, GROUP_CONCAT(item_id || ':' || count, '|') AS item_summary FROM pet_items WHERE count > 0 AND item_id NOT LIKE 'item_minesweeper_skin_%' AND item_id NOT LIKE 'item_gomoku_skin_%' GROUP BY account_id ) i ON i.account_id = a.account_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS skin_kind_count, SUM(count) AS skin_total_count, GROUP_CONCAT(item_id || ':' || count, '|') AS skin_summary FROM pet_items WHERE count > 0 AND ( item_id LIKE 'item_minesweeper_skin_%' OR item_id LIKE 'item_gomoku_skin_%' ) GROUP BY account_id ) s ON s.account_id = a.account_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS collection_kind_count, SUM(count) AS collection_total_count, GROUP_CONCAT(item_id || ':' || count, '|') AS collection_summary FROM pet_collections WHERE count > 0 AND discovered = 1 GROUP BY account_id ) c ON c.account_id = a.account_id
ORDER BY a.created_at DESC, a.account_id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
